name: AARI AI-native OS
short_description: AI-native operating system for behavioral health combining EHR, RCM, CRM, and supervision in one platform with AI-drafted notes and claims checking.
long_description: AARI is an AI-native operating system purpose-built for behavioral health practices. The platform unifies EHR, revenue cycle management, client relationship management, and clinical supervision on a single shared context layer that improves with every session. AI drafts clinical notes automatically from sessions, checks claims before submission, and helps supervisors identify what needs their attention first. Designed specifically for outpatient behavioral health including group practices, training clinics, and associate-therapist networks where supervision is central to operations.
one_liner: The AI-native operating system for behavioral health with integrated EHR, RCM, and supervision.
best_for: Group behavioral health practices needing unified EHR, billing, and CRM
Training clinics and associate-therapist networks requiring built-in supervision tools
Practices wanting AI-assisted documentation and claims processing
Organizations seeking measurable clinician development tracking
not_for: Solo practitioners seeking simple practice management
Large enterprise health systems with existing EHR infrastructure
Practices requiring specialized addiction treatment or residential features
Organizations needing integrated telehealth within the platform

pricing.notes: Custom pricing based on practice size and needs. Contact for quote.

compliance.notes: Platform describes itself as AI-native for behavioral health but explicit HIPAA compliance documentation not found on website.

faqs.a: AARI is an AI-native operating system for behavioral health that combines EHR, revenue cycle management, CRM, and clinical supervision in one platform. AI drafts notes from sessions, checks claims before submission, and helps supervisors prioritize their review work.

faqs.q: Who is AARI best suited for?
faqs.a: AARI is designed for outpatient behavioral health practices including group practices, training clinics, and associate-therapist networks where supervision and clinician development are core to operations.

faqs.q: Does AARI include clinical supervision tools?
faqs.a: Yes, AARI uniquely integrates supervision into care delivery, making clinician development measurable. Note review, sign-off, and skill tracking are built into the platform rather than added as separate features.
